  "summary": "The requirement SFMC-REQ-042 specifies that recovery from a software fault must preserve important mission data, which is a clear and testable fault management requirement. The SRS context in section 6 (Reliability and Fault Tolerance) supports this by including related requirements SFMC-REQ-040 and SFMC-REQ-041 addressing software failure prevention and automatic recovery. The requirement aligns with NASA-HDBK-2203-5.09 guidance (§3.2.1.9) on fault management requirements that ensure system resilience and data protection during faults. The requirement is well-written, unambiguous, and verifiable, with no vague terms or missing acceptance criteria. No direct NPR passages specifically mandate this exact requirement, so no SWE linkage is justified."
